observations.publisher: Pinned Jagex 3 November 2026 Quest Month update adds two 1,000-XP combat lamps to Black Knights' Fortress completion, two 1,000-XP combat lamps from Aris after Demon Slayer, and one 500-XP lamp each for Ernest the Chicken and Romeo & Juliet on completion.
observations.existing_catalog: Black Knights' Fortress, Ernest the Chicken and Romeo & Juliet already create the correct lamp quantity at their quest completion steps. Only the reward review ledger and Black Knights' tracked registry package needed collected status and producer references; no duplicate payout actions were created.
observations.new_claim: A distinct once-only claim.demon_slayer.aris at the existing pinned Aris tile (3204,3424,0) grants two combat lamp instances. Demon Slayer's completion action does not grant lamps, preventing double awards.
observations.draft_skill_rules: Aris combat lamps are modeled like the already collected Black Knights' combat lamps: seven conventional combat skills including Prayer, no known higher base-level gate (provisional minimum 1), retainable, one pick per lamp. Jagex states only combat lamp count/XP; verify those mechanics independently.
observations.legacy: Publisher notes older completions can claim some retroactive XP via Perdu or Lumbridge Guide. Those accounts' eligibility, any different Aris handling and repeat protection need a separate review; not silently double-paid in this fresh-completion batch.

review_gaps: Confirm Aris's exact option, whether the lamps are held or used in dialogue, and if a previously completed Demon Slayer account uses a different retroactive reward path.
Confirm the exact eligible combat skills and minimum base level for both the Aris and Black Knights' two-lamp packages; minimum level 1 and Prayer availability are provisional modeling assumptions.
Confirm whether the 500-XP Ernest and Romeo lamps are retainable and allow all skills. The existing catalog assumes retainable all-skills lamps with minimum level 1.
